title: How To Sell Anything With The StoryBrand Soundbite Strategy
description:
Get free marketing videos from Don every week at http://WeeklySoundbite.com

The reason people are ignoring you is you're speaking over their heads. Clever language. Vague messaging. Inside jargon. You need a sound bite strategy to grow your business.

In this video, I'll show you how to create a three-phase messaging campaign built on five StoryBrand sound bites that cover curiosity, enlightenment, and commitment. This is your marketing strategy from here on out.

What You'll Learn:
✅ The 5 StoryBrand sound bites that make customers pay attention
✅ Why your current messaging has a "cognitive load" of 100 (and how to get it to zero)
✅ The 3-phase messaging campaign framework (Curiosity → Enlightenment → Commitment)
✅ Real examples: How one company got 600% more clicks by changing 7 words
✅ The PEACE framework: Problem, Empathy, Answer, Change, End Result
✅ How to make your business look like a welcoming house (not a haunted one)
